author: Ubisoft
description:
Spring has arrived in Trackmania with a new seasonal campaign!
Discover 25 fresh tracks, including the return of the classic A08, a special final track by Eyebo, new Bobsleigh challenges, and 5 Black Tracks taking you across the esports circuit.

The Road to EWC & ENC continues with the Elite Cup Spring Season starting May 3rd!

Find 4 major racing events including Red Bull Faster and @FIAFormulaE Weekly Shorts.

New Prestige Skins are also available.

Read more 👉 https://www.trackmania.com/news/9077

ABOUT TRACKMANIA
Welcome to Trackmania — the unique racing game that combines precision and creativity. 

Trackmania® offers a unique, easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay experience with a wide diversity of tracks across five stunning environment (Red Island, Blue Bay, Green Coast, White Shore, and Stadium) along with regular content updates and live events:
- Face new racing challenges with Weekly Shorts and Weekly Grands, a new season every three months, and more player-made tracks
title: Trackmania Spring Season 2026 is here!
